'''Mace Windu's lightsaber''' was the [[Lightsaber/Legends|weapon]] wielded by the [[Mace Windu/Legends|Jedi Master]] during his career. It was unique among Jedi as it produced an amethyst blade when activated, rather than the more common green or blue. Windu wielded his lightsaber in many skirmishes and battles across the galaxy during notable events such as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. That conflict saw the blade used on battlefronts such as [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and others.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the lightsaber was lost when it was dropped out of the window of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] office prior to his death. In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Duros salvagers recovered it and sold it to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]].

==History==
In [[63 BBY]],<ref name="Windate1">[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] first conception of his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] takes place 41 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], 41 years after [[63 BBY]].</ref> a nine-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] first imagined his future [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], creating a detailed visualization of the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] in his mind before beginning its construction as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[60 BBY/Legends|three years later]].<ref name="Shatter" />

By [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]],<ref name="Windate2">The events of "[[Stones]]" take place fourteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu's]] birth, which [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] dates to [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]], fourteen years before [[58 BBY/Legends|58 BBY]].</ref> however, Windu had not completed a lightsaber despite his skill as a Jedi apprentice, giving rise to allegations from the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] that he was held back by fear. Seeking a challenge and a unique [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]], he was [[Mission to Hurikane|dispatched]] beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] to [[Hurikane]], his first mission alone. There, he was attacked by [[Unidentified Hurikane species|natives]] and evaded the stony beings with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Falling from a cliff while pursuing the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], one native's body was shattered, but Windu was able to reconstruct the individual piece&ndash;by&ndash;piece. In return, the natives presented him with several [[Color/Legends|violet]]-colored [[Hurrikaine crystal|crystals]],<ref name="Stones">{{Tales|13|Stones}}</ref> rare lightsaber components which produced a distinctive purple blade.<ref name="W&T" />

[[File:MaceWindu-SWITSB.png|thumb|left|220px|Mace Windu wielding his lightsaber]]
Prior to his ascension to the Jedi Council<ref name="CD">{{LivingForce|Coruscani Dawn}}</ref> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Windate3">{{DB|character|macewindu|Windu, Mace}} establishes that [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] ascended to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] 28 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after his birth, which [[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] dates to [[72 BBY/Legends|72 BBY]], 28 years before [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].</ref> Windu constructed a [[Mace Windu's practice lightsaber|purple-bladed lightsaber]] for the purpose of practice using crystals he had imbued himself. He lent the weapon to a Jedi Padawan who was later [[Death/Legends|killed]], along with her master, during a mission to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The saber subsequently passed through various hands before coming into the possession of [[Bleth Fahr]], an [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], who wielded it in battle against a group involved in the transport of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] the [[Pulas]] to the Jedi Council on the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|city–planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Though Windu built another to take its place, this lightsaber held emotional value to him. During this time, the Jedi Master had acquired a [[Coruscani lightsaber]]<ref name="CD" /> constructed by [[Jedi artisan/Legends|Jedi artisan]] [[Felanil Baaks]], which Windu gave as a gift<ref name="FBJA">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030313baaks|text=Felanil Baaks, Jedi Artisan}}</ref> to a Jedi student of the [[Almas Academy]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] as thanks for their part in the Pulas' delivery.<ref name="CD" />

Viewing his physical lightsaber as a mere expression of the weapon that existed in his mind, Windu adapted it as he grew in the Force, modifying it to reflect changes within himself.<ref name="Shatter" />

Sometime before [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Windu created a second lightsaber, in recognition of his position as a senior Jedi Council member. It was built to the highest standards, emphasizing precision and quality. The weapon incorporated an electrum finish reserved only for the most senior of council members, as well as the signature amethyst crystal of his earlier weapon. His second lightsaber served him throughout the galaxy-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="EP2">{{Film|II}}</ref> until his death at the hands of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] - who was the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious. The lightsaber plummeted out of the shattered window of the Chancellor's office after Windu's hand was severed by Anakin Skywalker, with its owner soon following.<ref name="EP3">{{Film|III}}</ref>
[[18 BBY/Legends|The following year]], a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] sold a broken lightsaber, which he claimed once belonged to Master Windu, to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]]. Though the claim was never verified, Senator Sauro displayed the lightsaber in question in his office.<ref name="A Tangled Web" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MaceWinduSaber-SWCTP.png|thumb|50px|Windu's saber]]
{{Quote|We had this big arena fight scene with all these Jedi, and I was like, 'I want to be able to find myself in this scene.' I said to George, 'You think I can get a purple lightsaber? I'm like the second baddest Jedi in the universe.'|Samuel L. Jackson on Windu's lightsaber|<ref name="Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection">''[[Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection]]''</ref>}}
Mace Windu's lightsaber first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']], the second installment of the [[Prequel trilogy]].<ref name="AOTC" /> The lightsaber's amethyst color was chosen by the actor portraying Windu, [[Samuel L. Jackson]], who wanted a purple lightsaber because he was "the second baddest Jedi in the universe" and so he could find himself among the many Jedi featured in the Battle of Geonosis scene.<ref name="Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection" />
